plugin_desc: ACKSYS industrial wireless SNMP child template for AirLink and related WaveOS devices (IANA PEN 28097). Beyond the shared Wireless SNMP floor for MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic, it collects heap free/total/low-water bytes, motherboard temperature in millicelsius (query scaled to Celsius), dual power-line state, AP client count, and bridge-mode RSSI in dBm. No CPU utilization object is exposed as a stable scalar, so CPU is N/A and not faked. Interface error counters, ifOperStatus and 32-bit octet counters are not expanded. Supported brands/models — ACKSYS AirLink industrial wireless access points, bridges and related WaveOS devices (enterprise 28097).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: heap_free_bytes
metrics.description: Currently available heap memory in bytes on the ACKSYS WaveOS platform (os-statFreeHeap, IANA PEN 28097). Sustained low free heap indicates memory pressure that can affect wireless forwarding or management services.

metrics.name: heap_total_bytes
metrics.description: Total heap size in bytes on the ACKSYS WaveOS platform (os-statTotalHeap, IANA PEN 28097). Together with free heap it is the denominator for heap utilization.

metrics.name: heap_low_water_bytes
metrics.description: Heap low-water mark in bytes on the ACKSYS WaveOS platform (os-statHeapLowWater, IANA PEN 28097). This is the lowest free-heap observation since the watermark was last reset and helps catch transient memory pressure.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Heap utilization of the ACKSYS WaveOS platform, derived as (total-free)/total from os-statTotalHeap and os-statFreeHeap (IANA PEN 28097). High usage indicates heap pressure rather than a vendor-reported CPU or general RAM percentage.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Motherboard sensor 0 temperature of the ACKSYS device (motherBoard0, IANA PEN 28097). The SNMP scalar reports millicelsius, so the query divides by 1000. Values at or below -274000 mC mean the sensor is unavailable and are excluded. High temperatures can indicate enclosure heat buildup or wireless hardware thermal stress.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power line 1 state of the ACKSYS industrial wireless device (powerStatus-PW1-state, IANA PEN 28097). Raw codes powerOn(2)/powerOff(1) are normalized to 1=normal / 2=abnormal. Dual-feed industrial models expose a second line as the backup state.

metrics.name: device_psu_state_backup
metrics.description: Power line 2 state of the ACKSYS industrial wireless device (powerStatus-PW2-state, IANA PEN 28097). Raw codes powerOn(2)/powerOff(1) are normalized to 1=normal / 2=abnormal.

metrics.name: wireless_client_count
metrics.description: Number of associated wireless clients on the ACKSYS access point (apClientCount, IANA PEN 28097). This scalar is significant in access-point mode. Per-client RSSI rows are not aggregated.

metrics.name: wireless_signal_strength
metrics.description: Bridge-mode connection RSSI in dBm on the ACKSYS device (bridge-modeRSSIdBm, IANA PEN 28097). This scalar is significant in bridge mode; access-point client RSSI is a per-row table and is not collected.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
